summary: I reviewed units s0039-s0057 of Jinshu 109 (Murong Huang). The 咸康三年 kingship and appointments are correctly dated to AD 337 (Jin Emperor Cheng, Xiankang 3). The pre-kingship campaigns are correctly expressed as the window AD 335-337, from the 咸康初 anchor up to the dated kingship. Murong Ren's execution (claim-351) is over-precise at a point year AD 335 given the qualitative anchor and the winter ice-crossing. The active hints for Duan Liao, Duan Lan and Murong Jun omit their dated activity in the supplied context claims. No omitted births, deaths or ages were found. I did no external research, and this is not a full-chapter approval.
